title: Marksman Rifle
description: Marksman rifles and other long-range precision primaries

title: Melee
description: Melee weapons (batons, blades, hammers and the like)

title: One-Handed
description: Weapons you can use one-handed, so a hand-held shield works with them (pistols, melee, some primaries)

title: Special
description: Odd-one-out primaries: Eruptor, Exploding Crossbow, Torcher, Evictor, Scythe

title: Expendable
description: One-use support weapons (Expendable Anti-Tank, Commando, Solo Silo and friends)

title: Non-Expendable Support
description: The regular support weapons: every support weapon that is not expendable

title: Impact
description: Throwables that go off on contact or home in on a target

title: Base Breaker
description: Can destroy structures: bug holes, fabricators, nests

title: Chaff Killer
description: Good at clearing swarms of small enemies

title: Panic Weapon
description: Quick-reaction weapons for when you are swarmed (primaries, secondaries and throwables)

title: Cooldown
description: Weapons that recharge or cool down instead of using a magazine (laser and arc weapons)

title: No Ammo
description: Never run out of ammo: charge weapons, expendable supports and Rovers

title: Supply
description: Items that resupply you (the Supply Pack and the Supply FRV)

title: Hand-Held Shield
description: Hand-held shields (they take up a hand)

title: Stealth
description: Helps you avoid being seen: smoke, quiet weapons, jump packs

title: Team Assist
description: Helps the team: shields, stuns, smoke, lures

title: Backpack
description: Everything that takes the backpack slot
